chapterInfo.content:
11
Wɔtwe ɔman no gyegyefoɔ no aso
1 # Hes 3.12 Na honhom no maa me so de me kɔɔ AWURADE fie no apueeɛ fam ponkɛseɛ a ɛkyerɛ apueeɛ no ano; na hwɛ, na mmarima aduonu nnum gyina ɔponkɛseɛ no ano, na mehunuu Asur ba Yaasania ne Benaia ba Pelatia, ɔman no mu mmapɔmma no, wɔ wɔn mu. 2Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Onipa ba, yeinom ne mmarima a wɔdwene abususɛm na wotu fo bɔne, kuro yi mu. 3Wɔse: Berɛ a wɔde sisi adan mpinkyɛnee. Kuro yi ne ɛsɛn no, na yɛne nam no. 4Ɛno nti, hyɛ wɔn ho nkɔm, hyɛ nkɔm, onipa ba!
5Na AWURADE honhom tɔɔ me so, na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Ka, sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Saa na moka, Israel fie, na deɛ ɛba mo adwene mu no, me deɛ, menim. 6Moama mo atɔfoɔ adɔɔso kuro yi mu, na mode atɔfoɔ funu ahyehyɛ emu mmorɔno so ma ma. 7Ɛno nti, sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Mo atɔfoɔ a mode agugu mu no, wɔne nam no, na kuro no ne ɛsɛn no, na mo deɛ, wɔbɛyi mo afiri mu. 8Nkrantɛ na mosuro, nso nkrantɛ ara na mede bɛba mo soɔ, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie. 9Na mɛyi mo afiri mu, na mede mo mahyɛ ananafoɔ nsa, na mɛbu mo atɛn. 10#2 Ah 25.20-21 Nkrantɛ ano na mobɛtotɔ, Israel hyeɛ so na mɛbu mo atɛn, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE. 11Kuro no renyɛ mo ɛsɛn, na mo nso morenyɛ mu nam; Israel hyeɛ so na mɛbu mo atɛn, 12na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE a moanni m’ahyɛdeɛ soɔ, na moanyɛ m’atemmudeɛ, na amanaman a wɔatwa mo ho ahyia no atemmudeɛ so na modiiɛ.
13 # Hes 9.8 Na ɛbaa sɛ merehyɛ nkɔm no, Benaia ba Pelatia wui. Ɛnna mede m’anim butuu fam de nne kɛseɛ suu sɛ: Ao, AWURADE Nyankopɔn, wie na worewie Israel nkaeɛ koraa?
Nyankopɔn man no foforɔyɛ
14Ɛnna AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 15Onipa ba, wo nuanom, wo nuanom mpo ne w’abusuafoɔ, ne Israel fie mu nyinaa, ne Yerusalemfoɔ na ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momfiri AWURADE ho nkɔ akyirikyiri, yɛn na wɔde asase yi ama yɛn sɛ yɛnni soɔ. 16#Hes 6.8-10; Yer 24.5-6 Ɛno nti ka sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Ɛwom sɛ mede wɔn kɔɔ akyirikyiri, amanaman mu, na mebɔɔ wɔn petee nsase so deɛ, nanso mayɛ wɔn kronkronbea kakra, nsase a wɔakɔ soɔ no so. 17#Yer 29.14 Ɛno nti ka sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Mɛboa mo ano afiri aman mu, na matase mo afiri nsase a wɔabɔ mo apete soɔ no so, na mede Israel asase no mama mo, 18na wɔbɛba hɔ abɛyi emu atantanneɛ nyinaa ne emu akyiwadeɛ nyinaa afiri mu akɔ. 19#Hes 36.26; Yer 24.7 Na mɛma wɔn akoma korɔ, na mede honhom foforɔ mahyɛ wɔn mu, na mayi ɔboɔ akoma no afiri wɔn honam mu, na mama wɔn honam akoma, 20#Yer 31.33 na wɔanante m’ahyɛdeɛ mu, na wɔadi m’atemmudeɛ so ayɛ, na wɔayɛ me ɔman, na me nso mayɛ wɔn Onyankopɔn. 21Na wɔn a wɔn akoma di wɔn atantanneɛ ne wɔn akyiwadeɛ akyire no deɛ, mede wɔn kwan bɛbua wɔn atifi, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie.
22 # Hes 1.4-28 Ɛnna Kerubim no memaa wɔn ntaban soɔ, na nkyimiiɛ no di wɔn nkyɛnmu, na Israel Nyankopɔn animuonyam no wɔ wɔn so wɔ soro. 23Na AWURADE animuonyam no maa ne ho so firii kuro no mu, na ɛkɔgyinaa bepɔ a ɛda kuro no anim no so. 24#Hes 3.12 Na honhom no maa me so de me kɔɔ Kaldea, atukɔfoɔ no nkyɛn, anisoadehunu mu, Nyankopɔn honhom mu. Na adeɛ a mehunuiɛ no firii me so kɔɔ soro. 25Na mekaa AWURADE nsɛm a ɔmaa mehunuiɛ no nyinaa kyerɛɛ atukɔfoɔ no.

Na honhom no maa me so de me kɔɔ AWURADE fie no apueeɛ fam ponkɛseɛ a ɛkyerɛ apueeɛ no ano; na hwɛ, na mmarima aduonu nnum gyina ɔponkɛseɛ no ano, na mehunuu Asur ba Yaasania ne Benaia ba Pelatia, ɔman no mu mmapɔmma no, wɔ wɔn mu. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Onipa ba, yeinom ne mmarima a wɔdwene abususɛm na wotu fo bɔne, kuro yi mu. Wɔse: Berɛ a wɔde sisi adan mpinkyɛnee. Kuro yi ne ɛsɛn no, na yɛne nam no. Ɛno nti, hyɛ wɔn ho nkɔm, hyɛ nkɔm, onipa ba!
Na AWURADE honhom tɔɔ me so, na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Ka, sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Saa na moka, Israel fie, na deɛ ɛba mo adwene mu no, me deɛ, menim. Moama mo atɔfoɔ adɔɔso kuro yi mu, na mode atɔfoɔ funu ahyehyɛ emu mmorɔno so ma ma. Ɛno nti, sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Mo atɔfoɔ a mode agugu mu no, wɔne nam no, na kuro no ne ɛsɛn no, na mo deɛ, wɔbɛyi mo afiri mu. Nkrantɛ na mosuro, nso nkrantɛ ara na mede bɛba mo soɔ, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie. Na mɛyi mo afiri mu, na mede mo mahyɛ ananafoɔ nsa, na mɛbu mo atɛn. Nkrantɛ ano na mobɛtotɔ, Israel hyeɛ so na mɛbu mo atɛn, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE. Kuro no renyɛ mo ɛsɛn, na mo nso morenyɛ mu nam; Israel hyeɛ so na mɛbu mo atɛn, na moahunu sɛ mene AWURADE a moanni m’ahyɛdeɛ soɔ, na moanyɛ m’atemmudeɛ, na amanaman a wɔatwa mo ho ahyia no atemmudeɛ so na modiiɛ.
Na ɛbaa sɛ merehyɛ nkɔm no, Benaia ba Pelatia wui. Ɛnna mede m’anim butuu fam de nne kɛseɛ suu sɛ: Ao, AWURADE Nyankopɔn, wie na worewie Israel nkaeɛ koraa?

Ɛnna AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: Onipa ba, wo nuanom, wo nuanom mpo ne w’abusuafoɔ, ne Israel fie mu nyinaa, ne Yerusalemfoɔ na ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Momfiri AWURADE ho nkɔ akyirikyiri, yɛn na wɔde asase yi ama yɛn sɛ yɛnni soɔ. Ɛno nti ka sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Ɛwom sɛ mede wɔn kɔɔ akyirikyiri, amanaman mu, na mebɔɔ wɔn petee nsase so deɛ, nanso mayɛ wɔn kronkronbea kakra, nsase a wɔakɔ soɔ no so. Ɛno nti ka sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Mɛboa mo ano afiri aman mu, na matase mo afiri nsase a wɔabɔ mo apete soɔ no so, na mede Israel asase no mama mo, na wɔbɛba hɔ abɛyi emu atantanneɛ nyinaa ne emu akyiwadeɛ nyinaa afiri mu akɔ. Na mɛma wɔn akoma korɔ, na mede honhom foforɔ mahyɛ wɔn mu, na mayi ɔboɔ akoma no afiri wɔn honam mu, na mama wɔn honam akoma, na wɔanante m’ahyɛdeɛ mu, na wɔadi m’atemmudeɛ so ayɛ, na wɔayɛ me ɔman, na me nso mayɛ wɔn Onyankopɔn. Na wɔn a wɔn akoma di wɔn atantanneɛ ne wɔn akyiwadeɛ akyire no deɛ, mede wɔn kwan bɛbua wɔn atifi, AWURADE Nyankopɔn asɛm nie.
Ɛnna Kerubim no memaa wɔn ntaban soɔ, na nkyimiiɛ no di wɔn nkyɛnmu, na Israel Nyankopɔn animuonyam no wɔ wɔn so wɔ soro. Na AWURADE animuonyam no maa ne ho so firii kuro no mu, na ɛkɔgyinaa bepɔ a ɛda kuro no anim no so. Na honhom no maa me so de me kɔɔ Kaldea, atukɔfoɔ no nkyɛn, anisoadehunu mu, Nyankopɔn honhom mu. Na adeɛ a mehunuiɛ no firii me so kɔɔ soro. Na mekaa AWURADE nsɛm a ɔmaa mehunuiɛ no nyinaa kyerɛɛ atukɔfoɔ no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
